name: Tinker's Goggles

effects.name: Intelligence
effects.tooltip: Intelligence +6 : This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.

effects.name: Treason
effects.tooltip: Treason : This item reduces the threat generated by melee damage by 20%.

effects.name: Disable Device
effects.tooltip: Disable Device +10 : Passive: +10 Competence bonus to the Disable Device skill.

effects.name: Enhanced Disable Device
effects.tooltip: Enhanced Disable Device +5 : Passive: +5 Enhancement bonus to the Disable Device skill.

effects.name: Nearly Finished - Tinker's Finesse
effects.tooltip: Tinker's Finesse : True Seeing , and equivalent to Sneak Attack Bonus +5 : Provides a +5 to attack rolls and +8 damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.

flavor_text: Goggles worn by House Cannith tinkers to enhance their vision, aiding them in working with small or intricate mechanisms.
tips: Notes: The True Seeing effect from the set bonus is bugged and doesn't work, but the Sneak Attack bonus does. UPDATE: As of U12.3 this effect is now working properly, but you may have to re-equip them after death (like other effects such as Tira's Splendor ). Tested by viewing the astral bug on the rune arm, Lucid Dreams . + + + +
